body:
Triage: graded `pm:queue` · `domain:devx` · type Task (first-touch). Fourth confirmed instance of the gate-naming blind spot and a new species: a population defined by file CONTENT (a test gaining a cross-package import), which no path literal can describe — the standing "run `pnpm lint` regardless" workaround demonstrably did not cover it (`check:test-source-alias` lives in the CI job, not the local lint script). The fix choice is the devx seat's. Routing note: if the chosen fix is the middle option (dispatch briefs name the CI job `Lint & Repo Gates` rather than `pnpm lint`), that half lands in dispatch-brief construction — skills lane — and should be handed over as its own card; the residue-text honesty fix (the `undetermined` bucket wording in `dispatch-gates.mjs`) stays here. Serial note: #9873 (same root shape, exclusion-defined population) is already in queue — check overlap on `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` at claim time; fold-or-serial is a must-answer if both are picked up.
